item.text: [{"task_id":"ecaa0ec1","source_lines":["def run(params, grid, demos):","    bg = int(round(params['colours'][0]))","    marker = int(round(params['colours'][1]))","    a = int(round(params['colours'][2]))","    b = int(round(params['colours'][3]))","    span = int(round(params['geometry'][0]))","    two = int(round(params['geometry'][1]))","    turns = int(round(params['geometry'][2]))","    one = int(round(params['geometry'][3]))","    pts = np.argwhere(grid == marker).tolist()","    obj = np.argwhere(np.logical_or(grid == a, grid == b))","    if len(pts) != turns or len(obj) == 0 or two <= 0 or one <= 0:","        return grid.copy()","    r0 = int(np.min(obj[:, 0]))","    r1 = int(np.max(obj[:, 0]))","    c0 = int(np.min(obj[:, 1]))","    c1 = int(np.max(obj[:, 1]))","    for i in range(len(pts)):","        cluster = [pts[j] for j in range(len(pts)) if j != i]","        lo_r = min(p[0] for p in cluster)","        hi_r = max(p[0] for p in cluster)","        lo_c = min(p[1] for p in cluster)","        hi_c = max(p[1] for p in cluster)","        if hi_r - lo_r != span or hi_c - lo_c != span:","            continue","        if not all(p[0] in [lo_r, hi_r] and p[1] in [lo_c, hi_c] for p in cluster):","            continue","        target_r = lo_r + hi_r - r0 - r1","        target_c = lo_c + hi_c - c0 - c1","        vr = two * pts[i][0] - r0 - r1","        vc = two * pts[i][1] - c0 - c1","        for k in range(turns):","            if vr == target_r and vc == target_c:","                out = grid.copy()","                out[out == marker] = bg","                block = grid[r0:r1 + one, c0:c1 + one]","                rotated = np.rot90(block, k)","                if rotated.shape != block.shape:","                    return grid.copy()","                out[r0:r1 + one, c0:c1 + one] = rotated","                out[(lo_r + hi_r) // two, (lo_c + hi_c) // two] = marker","                return out","            nr = int(round(params['rotation'][0])) * vr + int(round(params['rotation'][1])) * vc","            nc = int(round(params['rotation'][2])) * vr + int(round(params['rotation'][3])) * vc","            vr, vc = nr, nc","    return grid.copy()"],"shapes":{"colours":[4],"geometry":[4],"rotation":[4]},"params":{"colours":[0,4,1,8],"geometry":[2,2,4,1],"rotation":[0,-1,1,0]},"rationale":"Three yellow cells form an L at three corners of a square.
